risks.title: Decline in petroleum additives sales volumes
risks.score_rationale: The risk factor is central to the analysis of 2025 vs 2024 results, with a 4.9% decline in global volumes. The language is direct and repetitive, indicating a concerning trend. The Industrial category carries high weight here as it impacts the core business.

risks.title: Pressure on selling prices and margins
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as a negative impact on sales and profitability, with reference to price and product mix adjustments. Language intensity is moderate but recurring. Competitive pressure is implicit in the strategic decision to exit low-margin activities.

risks.title: Rising operating costs despite declining production
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes higher operating costs due to reduced production, increased technology investments and one-time charges. Language is alarming ('higher operating costs'), and the phenomenon directly impacts profitability of the main segment.

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainties and international trade risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in a dedicated section ('We continue to monitor'), with cautious language. It includes tariffs and trade relations, which could impact supply chain and demand. Less immediate than operational risks, but systemic.

risks.title: Integration of recent acquisitions (Calca, AMPAC)
risks.score_rationale: Acquisitions of Calca (2025) and AMPAC (2024) are recent and their integration is not yet fully assessed. The text notes that results include only periods of ownership, with one-time impacts (acquired inventory at fair value). Implicit risk of poorly managed integration.

risks.title: Foreign currency exposure
risks.score_rationale: Multiple key currencies are cited (euro, yen, renminbi, etc.), with direct impact on sales. Dollar strength against certain currencies partially offsets losses. Risk is real but partially hedged, hence moderate severity.

risks.title: Rising R&D investments with no guaranteed returns
risks.score_rationale: R&D increased to 5.2% of sales (vs 4.7% in 2024), with clear strategic objective. However, these investments are substantial and their return is not assured. Language is positive but implies technology risk and future profitability uncertainty.
